canonical_title: Cohere signs letter of intent to acquire AISLE AI cybersecurity
aliases: AISLE and Cohere to Join Forces
treatment: Do not treat LOI as a completed acquisition; revisit only for definitive deal, closure, new products or technical integrations.
known_facts: Cohere and AISLE announced an acquisition Letter of Intent on 15 October 2026; closing is not confirmed.
AISLE says its autonomous systems have discovered more than 500 assigned CVEs; this is the company's claim.
Upon completion AISLE leadership is expected to take roles in Cohere Cyber and AI Security; Prague office will join Cohere.
reinclude_only_if: Definitive agreement or completed acquisition confirmed.
Concrete Cohere Cyber product, model or benchmark integration published.
notes: Reuters 09:02 UTC = 18:02 JST; official AISLE post dated Oct 15.
